messages:
maria: quick heads-up — the new next-starter-converter sample is showing a duplicate first prompt when the SDK retry kicks in. seen it locally and in the eval harness.
kevin: ugh, that's bad. can you paste a minimal repro?
maria: repro steps: 1) run `npm run dev` on the starter 2) hit the /api/generate endpoint with a flaky token 3) SDK triggers retry and the initial user message is sent twice.
maria: snippet from server logs:
```
POST /api/generate 200 312ms
SDK retry attempt=1 reason=timeout
-> outbound payload:
{ prompt: "Summarize the article", messages: ["Summarize the article", "Summarize the article"] }
```
kevin: does the starter use our JS SDK directly or the small wrapper in examples/ ?
maria: it uses examples/utils/redwood-client.ts (thin wrapper) — I suspect the retry wrapper is accidentally re-invoking prompt serialization.
sam: tagging @kevin and @olivia — I ran something similar with the LangChain wiring last week, could be the SDK's idempotency handling for chat-style vs text-generation endpoints. :thinking_face:
olivia: can you share the wrapper code? maybe we forgot to strip the prompt from the retry payload.
maria: wrapper is tiny:
```ts
export async function callRedwood(payload) {
  try {
    return await redwood.client.generate(payload);
  } catch (e) {
    // simple retry
    return await redwood.client.generate(payload);
  }
}
```
kevin: there's your bug — payload is mutated later by the serialization layer, and we retry with the mutated object. should clone before first call or make SDK guarantee immutability.
sam: agreed. fix options: 1) deep-clone payload in our example wrapper, 2) update SDK to freeze/clone incoming payloads, 3) add test in the eval harness to catch duplicate messages on retry.
maria: for quick unblock I pushed a PR that deep-clones in the starter: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-starter/commit/abc123 — can folks review? :sparkles:
kevin: looking now. small nit: use structured clone or JSON to be safe with nested buffers, but note JSON loses binary bits if anyone attaches audio/attachments.
sam: for the eval harness we should add a golden prompt-check that asserts the sent prompt list length equals expected on retries. I'll sketch a test and open an issue.
olivia: also flagging that LangChain example uses the same thin wrapper. we should sweep all samples. I'll grep and open PRs.
maria: thanks. QUESTION: should we treat this as a DX bug (docs + samples) or SDK bug? I think samples are primary culprit but SDK could harden.
kevin: classify as DX/sample-first. file follow-up SDK ticket for immutability as a nice-to-have.
sam: +1. I'll add an eval harness test and link it in the PR.
devx-bot: new issue created: DEVEX-482 "starter: duplicate prompt on SDK retry" — https://tracker.redwood/DEVEX-482
maria: perfect. leaving the starter PR draft for now, will update with tests once sam's harness check lands. thanks all :raised_hands:
kevin: one last thought — add a comment in the example wrapper explaining why clone is needed (preventing payload mutation across retries). saves future head-scratching.
maria: will do.
